prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a hit while turning left. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1467; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the collision that occurred while our client was turning left at an intersection. Our client sustained injuries in the incident and is currently receiving medical care for them. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by phone, mail, or in person.

We ask that you provide a written statement of the liability coverage limits under the policy issued to the driver involved in the collision, along with the declarations page and any excess or umbrella coverage that may apply.

We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this claim. This includes photographs, vehicle data, dash camera or telematics records, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, and any repair or total-loss records for the vehicles involved. Please ensure that none of this material is altered, discarded, or repaired without prior notice to our office.

Kindly acknowledge receipt of this letter and confirm within fourteen days that the requested steps have been taken.
